To add apps to a group: <COMMAND: ADD_APP_TO_GROUP>GroupName|App1,App2</COMMAND>
To remove apps from a group: <COMMAND: REMOVE_APP_FROM_GROUP>GroupName|App1,App2</COMMAND>
To remove a group completely: <COMMAND: REMOVE_GROUP>GroupName</COMMAND>

To perform keyboard actions: <COMMAND: KEYBOARD_ACTION>holdKey | iterations | keyCombo | text</COMMAND> (Use 'none' for unused parts. ALWAYS use '+' to separate multiple keys, e.g. 'ctrl+c' or 'up+left'. Never use commas. e.g. <COMMAND: KEYBOARD_ACTION>none | 1 | enter | youtube.com</COMMAND>, <COMMAND: KEYBOARD_ACTION>win | 1 | up+left | none</COMMAND>, <COMMAND: KEYBOARD_ACTION>none | 1 | none | hello world</COMMAND>)
